list.description: HeroHubs is my tech blog and the brand I work under as a freelance developer. I publish articles in English and Italian on software development, architecture and artificial intelligence, written from what I run into on real projects.
achievements: Published more than 50 articles in two languages on tools, architectural choices and AI, from Claude Code and open models to serverless platforms.
Designed and built the site with Astro: bilingual content, per-language RSS feeds and a fully static deployment on GitHub Pages.
Run the editorial workflow end to end, from writing and AI-assisted translation to cover design and LinkedIn promotion.

list.description: Co-founded a startup focused on language learning. Designed and developed the entire front-end architecture of the platform using AngularJS, ensuring a responsive and consistent experience across web and mobile interfaces.
achievements: Designed and developed the front-end architecture using AngularJS, ensuring modularity and scalability.
Collaborated with the back-end team to integrate RESTful APIs and ensure a seamless user experience.
Contributed to the deployment of native Android and iOS apps as part of the broader multi-platform product strategy.
